name: Bitter-tomato porridge
summary: Porridge of mắc nhung, a green fruit in the tomato family that grows on the fields and the rock faces. Vietnam.vn, on 2 April 2024, calls it slightly bitter and pungent, with a little sweet finish. Stir-fry a little minced meat, then cook it with sticky rice and bone broth for many hours, with seasoning, bột nêm, fish sauce, ginger, and pepper. The fruit goes in last.
origin: Vietnam.vn, 2 April 2024. The fruit is described as common in Sơn La.
taste: Vietnam.vn says the fruit is slightly bitter and pungent, with a little sweet finish.
howToEat: As the porridge, with the fruit added at the end. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam.vn does not name a street. The fruit grows on nương and along the forest edge.
seoTitle: Chao mac nhung in Son La — bitter-tomato porridge
seoDescription: Cháo mắc nhung in Sơn La. Sticky rice, bone broth, minced meat, and mắc nhung last. Vietnam.vn calls the fruit slightly bitter, then a little sweet. Check on arrival.
